title: Answer the Bell
description: Finish Showdown matches with at least one solved round of your own. Both players must finish; all-skip attempts do not count.

title: Rival Conqueror
description: Win completed Showdown matches after solving at least one round yourself. Cancelled, declined and expired invitations are excluded.

title: Light the Way
description: Activate every receiver in Prism Break rounds from completed matches. Skips and rounds still waiting for an opponent do not count.

title: Crystal Precision
description: Solve Prism Break rounds in the verified minimum rotations. Only completed matches count; resets never refund used rotations.

title: Prismatic Peak
description: Reach these three-round Prism Break totals in a completed match. This is your best single match, never a sum across games.

title: Club Circuit
description: Finish Showdown matches against different club rivals, solving at least one round yourself. Repeat matches against one rival count once.
